Discord & Telegram C2 Traffic Detection.description: Detect Discord and Telegram being used as Command & Control (C2) channels via API traffic patterns, webhook calls, and unusual bot API usage.

commands.description: Capture all HTTPS traffic to Discord API (potential C2 bot)
commands.command:
tshark -i eth0 -f 'host discord.com or host discordapp.com' -Y 'tcp.port == 443'
# Wireshark filter: ssl.handshake.extensions_server_name contains "discord"

commands.description: Filter Discord CDN and API traffic by TLS SNI
commands.command:
ssl.handshake.extensions_server_name contains "discord" or ssl.handshake.extensions_server_name contains "discordapp"
# Look for: gateway.discord.gg (WebSocket C2 channel)

commands.description: Detect Telegram bot API calls (api.telegram.org)
commands.command:
tshark -i eth0 -f 'host api.telegram.org' -Y 'tcp.port == 443'
# Wireshark filter: ssl.handshake.extensions_server_name == "api.telegram.org"

commands.description: Detect high-frequency polling to Discord/Telegram API (C2 beacon pattern)
commands.command: tshark -i eth0 -r capture.pcap -Y 'ssl.handshake.extensions_server_name contains "discord" or ssl.handshake.extensions_server_name contains "telegram"' -T fields -e ip.src -e frame.time | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn

commands.description: Detect Discord webhook POST requests (data exfiltration via webhook)

commands.command: tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -s0 -w discord_telegram_c2.pcap 'host discord.com or host discordapp.com or host api.telegram.org or host t.me'
